result.document_summary: A middle fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 3, Division 35) on massage establishment and massage therapist permits, which the source URL mislabels as an algorithmic rent-pricing division.
result.notes: This part contains only massage therapist and massage establishment permit provisions (application contents, grounds for denial, exemptions, renewal, equipment, hours, posting). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, tenant screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The source URL slug refers to a division on prohibiting algorithmic rent price-fixing (98.1103), but the text of that provision does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted.
